course_points.n: At roundabout, take exit 2 onto Hans-Böckler-Straße
Turn right onto Konrad-Adenauer-Ufer and drive toward Boppard, Hauptbahnhof, Kurfürstliches Schloss, Koblenz-Altstadt
Keep right and drive toward Rizzastraße
Turn sharp right onto Emser Straße
At roundabout, take exit 1 onto Westallee
Turn sharp right onto B 42 and take B 42 toward Rüdesheim
Turn right and drive toward Boppard
Leave ferry and continue onto Anleger KD
